**Issue with the most Donald A. Yerxa articles: Volume 10, Number 4 (September 2009)**  

*In that single issue Donald A. Yerxa is the author of **two** articles:*  

| Article Title | Page Range (PDF) | Notes |
|---------------|------------------|-------|
| **“Last Rites: A Conversation with John Lukacs”** | pp. 9‑10 | Interview‑style essay. |
| **“The Historian’s Notebook: An Interview with ...”** | pp. 13‑14 | Second interview in the same issue. |

These two pieces make Volume 10‑Number 4 the issue with the greatest representation of Yerxa’s writing in the 2009 volume.
